definitions: The action of conferring or bestowing power, property, or rights upon someone.
The process by which an employee gains a non-forfeitable right to benefits, typically from a pension plan or stock option.
The act of clothing someone in ecclesiastical vestments.
examples: The vesting of authority in the new committee was a key step.
Employees are concerned about the vesting schedule for their shares.
The vesting of the bishop in his ceremonial robes marked the start of the service.
